# @trysac/json-repair

> Repairs truncated or malformed JSON returned by an LLM. A single-pass TypeScript library with no runtime dependencies for Node.js 20+ and browsers, published as ES modules with type declarations. Returns the value, the repaired text and an offset-annotated list of fixes. MIT.
